_what: Permission strings that the APPLIED migration 20260727_rbac_resource_action_flip.sql stripped from member arrays (its R-B2 `NOT IN (…)` filter), and that have since been DELIBERATELY WIRED — each with the ruling that wired it. Asserted by capQ (qListViolations) in scripts/verify-universals.mjs.
_why_a_declaration_and_not_a_fix: capQ's retained direction is 'a string the migration STRIPPED must still be un-grantable', and it has teeth: if someone wires one without flipping its status, the model and the migration disagree about a string that was taken away from real members. But the migration is APPLIED and §6 r1 forbids editing it, so its list is a HISTORICAL SNAPSHOT of what was stripped on 2026-07-27 — and a string can legitimately leave it later, by ruling. Without this file the cap offers only two moves, both wrong: edit an applied migration, or never wire any of those eight strings again. Tech-debt #90 is BLOCKED on exactly this, and 2026-08-28 hit it from the other side.
_the_bar: An entry is admissible only if (a) a RULING wired the string, named here with its date, and (b) something actually ENFORCES it — a policy or an RPC, named here by file. A string wired in the manifest but enforced by nothing is a fake pill and does NOT belong here; it belongs back at `declared-unwired` until its enforcement ships.
_this_list_prunes_itself: The cap asserts these in BOTH other directions, and both FAIL THE BUILD. (1) A declaration for a string that is STILL declared-unwired or planned in the manifest is STALE — the wiring was reverted, or the entry was written ahead of it, and either way the file is now claiming something untrue. (2) A declaration for a string the 20260727 snapshot never held is MEANINGLESS — it declares an exemption from an assertion that was never going to fire. This is the shape select-policy-declarations.json uses, and for the same reason: verify-universals' own OWNER_ONLY_PENDING is a hardcoded gap list that only grows, six of nine entries are stale, and it prints on every run — which is how a gap list stops being read (tech-debt #73). A list that cannot rot is the fix.
_added: 2026-08-28 — the OWNER-role-carries-authority pass (Stage 1). Three of the snapshot's eight strings were wired in one commit, and capQ correctly refused the build until the change was recorded as a decision rather than absorbed as a diff.

declarations.service_offerings:create: WIRED 2026-08-28 by David's ruling that the OWNER role carries full authority. It was declared-unwired because the only write policy on service_offerings was `service_offerings_owner` — a FOR ALL with `with_check` NULL, so its `owner_id = auth.uid()` USING clause governed writes too, and no member-held string could authorize one. ENFORCED BY: policy `service_offerings_member_insert` (supabase/migrations/20260828_owner_role_carries_authority.sql §1), `is_active_member(business_id) AND has_permission(business_id, 'service_offerings:create')`.
declarations.service_offerings:update: WIRED 2026-08-28, same ruling and same reason as service_offerings:create. This is the string the edit form AND the On/Off (is_active) retire toggle both ride — which matters because R2 still withholds a delete verb and retire-by-flag is therefore the only way a service leaves the menu. ENFORCED BY: policy `service_offerings_member_update` (20260828 §1), USING and WITH CHECK both `is_active_member(business_id) AND has_permission(business_id, 'service_offerings:update')`.
declarations.team:create: WIRED 2026-08-28, same ruling. It was declared-unwired because `invitations` carried exactly one policy — `inv_owner_all`, owner_id-scoped — so an OWNER-ROLE member who is not the account holder could not invite anyone. ENFORCED BY: the RPC `create_invitation` (20260828 §4), which authorises on it via has_permission_for BEFORE writing and resolves the invitee's permission array SERVER-SIDE from the role floor; plus policies `invitations_member_select` and `invitations_member_update` (20260828 §2), which gate listing and withdrawing a pending invite on the same string. ⚠️ `team:update` and `team:delete` are NOT declared here and remain declared-unwired: role assignment is the funnel's (assign_member_role), and tech-debt #90 proposes removing both verbs outright rather than leaving them mis-described.
